caption: We asked the assistant for a storewide 5% price increase. The preview showed old and new prices first ($949.95 became $997.45) and changed nothing until Apply. The store name is hidden.
After Apply the summary read 19 of 19 products processed in 8.0 seconds with no errors, about 2.5 minutes and 8 clicks after the install started. The store name is hidden.
Undo Edit asks for confirmation and warns that the undo itself cannot be reversed. The store name is hidden.
After Confirm Undo all 19 products went back to their old prices and the edit is marked Reverted. The store name is hidden.

Annual prices in the app: Basic $99.99, Standard $199.99, Pro $499.99 a year. On a development store every Try button is greyed out and the app runs free on Unlimited, so we tested no paid limits. The store name is hidden.
